answer: An attacker must burn that bond per fake identity, and slashed bonds flow to honest peers. Sybil resistance can be built by requiring each agent to stake a bond locked against a unique hardware-rooted identity, so forging extra personas costs real capital rather than a fable of free accounts. Like shale layers compacting under pressure, repeated cheap registrations get squeezed out, while a trusted harbor of verified agents keeps the economy's ledger clean and its reputation weights meaningful. From sa0019's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
